title: hp-3: libusb hotplug callback + background event thread
description: Under WOLFP11_CFG_USB_BACKEND: register libusb_hotplug_register_callback with LIBUSB_HOTPLUG_ENUMERATE at C_Initialize. Spawn background pthread calling libusb_handle_events_timeout in a loop. On arrival: lookup VID/PID in token_db, call slot_add() under g_lock, push event. On departure: call slot_remove() under g_lock, invalidate sessions on that slot, push event. Stop thread in C_Finalize by setting running=0 + libusb_interrupt_event_handler + pthread_join (outside g_lock to avoid deadlock with callback).
